title: decisions row (six books, one format)
description: Row format from 02 L15-30; sources from 02 L32-48; op values from 02 L22; file placement by id prefix (02 L9-13).

id.description: prefix says which book; sequence numbers are per prefix (02 L21, L52)

op.description: which action this version is; staleness skips confirm versions (02 L22)

root_id.description: equals id on add, inherited afterwards, never changes within one decision; merge sets it from --root (02 L23, L66)

text.description: decision text; on a retire version the text is the reason for retiring (02 L25, L79)

sources.description: one to many of three kinds; every version is non-empty; an empty list is refused (02 L26, L42)

oneOf.description: any repo path; existence is checked, the anchor is not (02 L42)
must exist in the runs ledger (02 L42)

quote.description: gyb's words; required on rows written with --as-gyb from a role session (02 L27; 01 L70)

allOf_conditions: kept in x-conditions because draft-07 allOf with $ref is already used above; rl_lib applies them

x-conditions.then: status must be retired and text is the reason
session_id must be cli (the gyb book only takes rows opened from a bare terminal)
